job.organization: Madera Unified School District - Personnel Commission

items.item_text: 01. I understand that, to be eligible to take the assessment, my application must demonstrate that I meet the minimum experience requirement of one (1) year of experience working with children in a specialized learning environment. Options: Yes | No
02. Do you have a high school diploma or equivalent? Options: Yes | No

03. I understand that passing the Paraprofessional Assessment does not automatically qualify me for Paraprofessional positions and I will still be required to apply for those positions as they become available. Options: Yes | No

04. I understand that the assessment details, including the testing location and time, will be emailed to registered participants who meet the minimum education and experience requirements after the registration period closes. Options: Yes | No
